intro: The Tear Garden is a psychedelic/experimental/electronic band formed by Edward Ka-Spel of the Legendary Pink Dots and cEvin Key of Skinny Puppy in 1985 after Key served as a sound engineer on tour in Canada for Ka-Spel.
